purpose: Inputs for the secondary subnational (Nigerian state) burden calculation for 2024 (R_cbh/burden/05_nigeria_state_burden.R).
source_label: IHME GBD Data Explorer / Results Tool exports for the 37 Nigerian states (36 states and FCT)
data_suite: Exports identify the data suite as GBD (1990-2024); the exact release/version is not stated in the files and remains unverified, as for the national IHME inputs.
retrieved: Exported by the analyst on 2026-09-16 (all causes) and 2026-09-16 or earlier (malaria); copied here from the Small Area Estimation project on 2026-09-17.

files.file: Data Explorer - export_trigger_table - All causes - Deaths - Rate (per 100,000), Number in Abia, Adamawa,...  2026-09-16 13-53-49.csv
files.description: All-cause under-5 deaths by GBD age group and state, both sexes, Number and Rate per 100,000, 2000-2025. Population per age group is recovered as Number / Rate x 100,000.

files.file: GBD NG Malaria mortality incidence prevalence rates 2011-2024.csv
files.description: Under-5 malaria deaths, incidence and prevalence rates per 100,000 by state, both sexes, 2011-2024; the 2024 death rate is the cause-specific comparator.
